reviewBasis: Visual inspection of every unique downloaded candidate plus source-page context

groups.reason: Used by the legacy public site as responsive logo artwork, but only 72x72 raster files are available; owner approval, vector source, clear space, and production sizing remain missing.
Legacy public-site favicon; the 32x32 raster is useful only as a reference and is not approved production artwork.
Factory exterior visibly carries AIRTEK POWER signage, but current facility identity, image rights, and the legacy spaced wordmark require owner confirmation.
Aerial factory image is published in a company-branch article, but the image has no identifying signage; confirm location, ownership, date, and usage rights.
Company ISO 9001:2015 certificate image shows validity through 2026-03-30, which predates the 2026-09-14 capture; retain only as historical evidence and do not publish.
Generic exhibition and outdoor-event photos contain no AIRTEKPOWER people, signage, booth, or other verifiable company identity; rights and relevance are unproven.
Generic world-map graphic supports a 100+ countries claim that the brand claim guardrails mark provisional; it has no standalone verified brand value.
SGS, UL Product iQ, GTS, and ICG files are product or component compliance material, not company brand or enterprise-system certificates.
Legacy site placeholder and rating-state graphics are interface artifacts, not AIRTEKPOWER brand assets.
Product fans, product banners, and repeated consumer humidifier/demo imagery are outside the company-brand-only scope.
